@graph.name: One Pot Broccoli Chicken Mac and Cheese
@graph.description: Recipe video above. The most amazing creamy Mac and Cheese with chicken and broccoli that's made in one pot! This recipe requires the specific ratio of water, milk and macaroni that I've specified in the recipe. Don't be alarmed at how much liquid there is when you take it out of the oven before broiling/grilling the top. You will be surprised how quickly the liquid evaporates into a thick sauce. Watch the video to see how easy this is to make!*Note: recipe has been updated slightly to streamline the process and add a touch more flavour to the chicken. A new video reflecting the new steps is coming soon!*
recipeIngredient: 500g / 1 lb  chicken thigh fillets,  (skinless and boneless, cut into small bite size pieces)
1/2 tsp cooking salt / kosher salt ((halve for table salt, +50% for flakes))
3 cups milk (, full fat best but low fat is fine)
2 cups chicken stock / broth (, low sodium)
3/4 tsp cooking salt / kosher salt ((halve for table salt, +50% for flakes))
1  large head of broccoli (, broken into florets (or 1 1/2 smaller ones))

recipeInstructions.text: Sauté onion - Melt butter over high heat in a large deep oven-proof skillet (30cm/12" wide), or use a large pot. Add onion and cook for 2 minutes.
recipeInstructions.name: Sauté onion - Melt butter over high heat in a large deep oven-proof skillet (30cm/12" wide), or use a large pot. Add onion and cook for 2 minutes.

recipeInstructions.text: Cook chicken - Add the chicken and garlic, and sprinkle the garlic powder, salt and pepper over. Cook, stirring, until the surface of the chicken is sealed.
recipeInstructions.name: Cook chicken - Add the chicken and garlic, and sprinkle the garlic powder, salt and pepper over. Cook, stirring, until the surface of the chicken is sealed.

recipeInstructions.text: Creamy sauce - Reduce heat to medium high and add flour. Stir until you no longer see white flour. Pour in the stock and stir until it turns milky from the flour dissolving into the liquid. Add milk, salt and pepper. Turn the heat up to high and stir.
recipeInstructions.name: Creamy sauce - Reduce heat to medium high and add flour. Stir until you no longer see white flour. Pour in the stock and stir until it turns milky from the flour dissolving into the liquid. Add milk, salt and pepper. Turn the heat up to high and stir.

recipeInstructions.text: Macaroni and broccoli - Add macaroni, stir, then once you start seeing bubbles, spread the broccoli across the surface.
recipeInstructions.name: Macaroni and broccoli - Add macaroni, stir, then once you start seeing bubbles, spread the broccoli across the surface.

recipeInstructions.text: Bake 20 minutes - Cover with a lid and transfer to the oven. Bake 20 minutes.
recipeInstructions.name: Bake 20 minutes - Cover with a lid and transfer to the oven. Bake 20 minutes.

recipeInstructions.text: Crunchy topping - Meanwhile, mix the Crunchy Topping ingredients together.
recipeInstructions.name: Crunchy topping - Meanwhile, mix the Crunchy Topping ingredients together.

recipeInstructions.text: Cheese and crunch it! Remove the pan from the oven. Flick to oven grill/broiler on high. Remove lid. Scatter with cheese then gently (but quickly!) stir through. It might look a bit watery still, that's good! It will thicken quickly into a creamy sauce. Smooth surface, then sprinkle with Topping.
recipeInstructions.name: Cheese and crunch it! Remove the pan from the oven. Flick to oven grill/broiler on high. Remove lid. Scatter with cheese then gently (but quickly!) stir through. It might look a bit watery still, that's good! It will thicken quickly into a creamy sauce. Smooth surface, then sprinkle with Topping.

recipeInstructions.text: Golden topping - Place under the broiler/grill for 3 to 5 minutes, or until top is golden. By this time excess liquid will be absorbed by the pasta and the sauce will be thickened and creamy.
recipeInstructions.name: Golden topping - Place under the broiler/grill for 3 to 5 minutes, or until top is golden. By this time excess liquid will be absorbed by the pasta and the sauce will be thickened and creamy.

recipeInstructions.text: Serve immediately while hot and oozy and creamy!

review.reviewBody: I do not know what I am doing wrong. Tried penne. The Mezzo Rigatoni. Both take close to an hour for the pasta to cook. Had to add more fluid, so watery. Any advice? Thinking of blanching the pasta first next time
